title: What If You Wore Glasses That Flipped the World Upside Down?

scenes.text: What if you wore glasses that flipped the whole world upside down? Your brain would fight back.
Your eyes already see everything upside down. Your brain flips it back so quickly you never notice.
In 1946, psychologist Ivo Kohler wore flipping spectacles for 124 days, around the clock.
For the first three days, the world looked upside down, and people grabbed cups the wrong way up.
By day five, the clumsiness faded. From day six, vision looked upright again.
Then he took the glasses off, and the real world looked upside down again, for a few minutes.

description:
What if you wore glasses that flipped the world upside down?
In a 124-day experiment, volunteers' brains adapted within about a week, and the real world looked flipped when the glasses came off.
What should we run through next?
